descriptionPlain:
About Lalamove
Lalamove is an on-demand delivery technology company, empowering users all around the world to make delivery fast and reliable.
Today, Lalamove operates in 14 markets across Asia, Latin America and EMEA. Our driver partners operate a vast array of vehicles to suit each market including lorries, vans and cars for deliveries of almost anything of any size. Fleets of two-wheel vehicles are also available for courier services providing fast and low-cost delivery solutions. Through dedicated mobile and web apps, Lalamove seamlessly connects users and drivers around the world to move things that matter.
We are currently looking for an outgoing, energetic and detail-oriented individual to join our Account Management team based in Manila. We want individuals who can help us achieve business targets by creating and maintaining professional relationships with business clients.

lists.content:
1. Account Growth

  • Develop and execute account growth plans for assigned clients
  • Increase revenue and order volume through upselling, cross-selling, and service adoption
  • Identify new business opportunities within existing accounts
  • Drive client utilization of Lalamove's products and solutions
  • Monitor client performance and provide recommendations to maximize logistics efficiency

    • 2. Account Retention

    • Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders
    • Conduct regular business reviews and performance discussions
    • Proactively identify and address risks that may lead to churn
    • Resolve client concerns and coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely solutions.
    • Develop retention strategies for at-risk accounts
    • Ensure a seamless customer experience throughout the account lifecycle

      • 3. Portfolio Management

      • Manage a portfolio of business accounts across different segments
      • Prioritize accounts based on revenue potential, strategic importance, and growth opportunities
      • Maintain accurate account records, forecasts, and pipeline updates
      • Track account health and engagement metrics

        •

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field (preferred).
  • At least two (2) years of experience in Corporate Account management functions from any industry.
  • Proficiency in CRM platforms like Salesforce, HubSpot, Freshsales
  • Must be willing to work on-site in Parañaque Integrated Terminal Exchange (PITX) and do fieldwork activities at times

descriptionPlain:
Lalamove is disrupting the logistics industry by connecting customers and drivers directly through our technology. We offer customers a lightning fast and convenient way to book delivery and moving services whether they are at their home, at work or on the go. People talk about O2O, we live it! 
 
Our strength lies in our internal values, namely Passion in serving local communities, empowering SMEs and our driver partners, Execution and Grit because that is how we differentiate ourselves by never giving up and striving for excellence, and Humility - awareness in ourselves to learn from others and never stop improving.
 
At Lalamove, we strongly believe in the power of community. Millions of drivers and customers use our technology every day to connect with one another and move things that matter. Delivery is what we do best and we ensure it is always fast and simple. Since 2013, we have tackled the logistics industry head on to find the most innovative solutions for the world’s delivery needs. 
 
Our vision is to bring communities closer and make city life easier by allowing fast and convenient circulation of goods. We realize this vision with a ‘glocal’ approach, building a robust operations team to adapt our product to local networks of businesses and delivery contractors. At the same time, we have ambition to build an international brand by establishing  an even more global presence.
 
As an Account Executive, you will be in charge of growing and retaining our demand from Business Clients in Indonesia and report to the Business Development Manager.  Quick wits, problem solving and a “team first” mentality will be critical to your success.  This role is a unique opportunity to have a measurable impact on your market through the growth of business clients on the Lalamove platform.
Think you are up for it? Apply now and join us as #OneLalamove!
The recruitment process will be carried out in English, and only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

lists.content:
• Act as the primary point of contact for customer account management and establish trusted relationships with key accounts and stakeholders

  • Ensure timely and successful delivery of solutions aligned with client needs and objectives

  • Identify opportunities in existing accounts for cross-selling and upselling, driving revenue growth and customer value

  • Negotiate contracts and close agreements to maximize profits

  • Clearly communicate the progress of monthly/quarterly initiatives to internal and external stakeholders

  • Proactively develop new business with existing clients and identify areas for improvement

  • Forecast and track key account metrics to inform strategic decision-making and drive business growth

  • Assist with challenging client requests or issue escalations as needed

  • Planning, executing and evaluating retention program

• Leadership skill to deal with a large and diverse Lalamove community

  • Strong sense of prioritization and structured mindset to cover multiple things at the same time, without compromising on quality

  • Ability to stand firm with integrity when deciding for the company in every situation

  • Data-driven to identify leverages and make decisions for the business in every situation

  • Strong verbal and communication skill to articulate ideas clearly through the use of a structured approach with proven ability to create framework

• BA/BS degree in Business Administration or relevant field

  • Proven work experience as an Account Manager, Key Account Manager, Sales Account Manager, Junior Account Manager or relevant role

  • Skilled in data analytics tools and reporting

  • Solid experience with CRM software (e.g. Freshworks, Salesforce, or Zoho CRM) and MS Office (particularly MS Excel and MS Powerpoint)

• Mainly responsible for Account Management (AM) Group KPI in revenue & maintain relationships with key accounts and customer visits according to set tiers of corporate customers to generate sales volumes & revenues through upselling, retention, and reactivation activities;
  • Working closely and coordinating with internal stakeholders in handling service failure, billing issues, customer complaints, and other inquiries;
  • Roll out periodic surveys on existing corporate customer cohorts from time to time to identify market insights;
  • Collaborate with the marketing department on regular and seasonal campaigns and oversee the overall campaign timeline to ensure the integration plan is finished as committed to expected output quality.
  • Others: Ad-hoc tasks/works assigned by Line Manager.
  • Work location: Pho Quang Street, Tan Son Hoa Ward, HCMC
  • Work time: Monday to Friday (9:00 AM to 6:00 PM)

• Self-motivated, proactive, take ownership and personal responsibility;
  • Hardworking & friendly team player, enthusiastic and adaptable;
  • Fast learner, can-do attitude, straightforward  and simplify;

• Bachelor/ College's degree, preferably in marketing or business related subjects;
  • Min 2 years solid experience in working experience in sales, account management, & customer support;
  • Good sense with product flow  & merchant solutions; high skill in campaign management;
  • Able to work independently and work under pressure;
  • Proficiency in written Vietnamese & English;
  • Hands-on experience with MS Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
